== Notes ==
* Combine with skills that trigger "on hit", as there are likely 2 hits.
* Bonus damage (i.e. from [[Conjure spell]]s, [[Glass Arrows]] and certain [[weapon spell]]s) is not reduced.
* This skill triggers [[Empathy]] only once, as it targets a single foe.
